title: Field Marketing Executive
description:
**HIRING – FIELD MARKETING EXECUTIVE**

**Location:** PALAKKAD , Kerala  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month + Incentives  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** Freshers & Experienced candidates can apply

Job Responsibilities

* Visit potential customers and generate new leads.
* Promote company products/services in the assigned area.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Follow up with leads and convert them into customers.
* Achieve monthly marketing and sales targets.
* Conduct market surveys and collect customer feedback.
* Maintain daily reports of visits, leads, and follow-ups.
* Coordinate with the sales and marketing team.

Requirements

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Self-motivated and target-oriented.
* Willingness to travel within Calicut and nearby areas.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
* Malayalam and English communication skills preferred.
* Freshers are welcome.

Benefits

* Fixed salary: **₹15,000 – ₹20,000/month**
* Attractive performance incentives
* Travel allowance as applicable
* Training and career growth opportunities

**Interested candidates can apply now!**

title: Sales & Marketing Executive / Business Development Officer
description:
Wanted **Business Development Executive** at *Cindrebay Skills – Koc*hi

**Job Title:**

**Business Development Executive – Student Outreach \& Engagement**

**Location:**

Kozhikode, Kerala

**Division:**

Cindrebay Skills (Part of CIndrebay School of Design)

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a dynamic and confident Marketing Executive to represent **Cindrebay Skills**, our new vertical offering career\-focused programs in **Interior / Graphic Design, CAD, BIM, Architecture Visualisation, MEP**, and **Project Management**. The role involves visiting colleges and educational institutions across the Kozhikode district, collecting student data, and securing appointments for seminars, workshops, and promotional events.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visit schools, colleges, and training institutes in the Kozhikode district to promote Cindrebay Skills’ programs
* Collect student databases and maintain systematic records of outreach efforts
* Schedule and coordinate seminars, presentations, and workshops in educational institutions
* Build strong relationships with institution heads, faculty, and student bodies
* Communicate program details clearly and confidently to students and faculty
* Represent Cindrebay Skills with professionalism, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Provide weekly reports and updates to the marketing team
* Support event coordination, lead generation campaigns, and follow\-ups

**Eligibility Criteria:**

* Age: **20 to 25 years**
* Minimum: **Graduate in any discipline** (final\-year students may also apply)
* **Well\-groomed, confident, and presentable personality**
* **Excellent communication skills in Malayalam** (English and Hindi will be a plus)
* Good manners, punctuality, and strong discipline are essential
* **Two\-wheeler driving license preferred**
* Prior experience in educational marketing or student outreach is an advantage but not mandatory

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives
* Opportunities for rapid growth within the organization
* Exposure to the dynamic field of design and technical skills education
* Professional development, training, and mentoring support
* A youthful, vibrant, and respectful work culture

**If you are ambitious, energetic, and passionate about building a career in educational marketing—this is your chance to shine.**

**Apply now and be a part of the Cindrebay Skills movement.**

To know more about us please visit our website www.cindrebay.com

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* West Hill, Calicut, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
